turns.input: Niles Vanner gives Nicco a pair of leather boots.
turns.narration: Niles Vanner reaches into a reinforced pocket of his waistcoat and withdraws a pair of worn leather boots, holding them out with the flat patience of a man who has completed many such transactions. "These should serve. Sturdy enough for walking, nothing that draws notice." Nicco takes the boots from him.

turns.input:
Thanks *he said to them, after which he decides to give them back the boots*
You'll need them more than me
turns.narration:
Nicco thanks Niles and offers the boots back, suggesting he might need them more.

Niles studies him with that patient, analytical expression, thumb stilling on the counter balance pan he'd been spinning. "I appreciate the thought," he says, making no move to take them. "But I've footwear enough, and those won't fetch me anything I don't already have. You keep them. Walking Calderan in whatever you arrived in—" he glances at Nicco's feet without lingering, "—that'll cost you more than pride."
